sellThenNews.title: WSB 情绪分析
sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 5 月 21 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：NVDA、SNDK、IBM、MU、MSFT。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Iran-US Draft Agreement Rumors: Al Arabiya / IRNA cited that the US and Iran, mediated by Pakistan, have "reached a final draft," including guarantees for passage through the Strait of Hormuz + phased lifting of sanctions + follow-up negotiations within 7 days. Rubio repeatedly signaled "deal is close" throughout the day, but no official signing occurred.
  • Iran Supreme Leader Khamenei's Directive: Ordered that near-weapon-grade uranium must remain within Iran; high-ranking Iranian officials later denied this as "enemy propaganda"—the market initially tanked in the morning, then saw a V-shaped rebound following the denial.
  • NVDA Post-Earnings Performance Muted: Q1 EPS $1.87 vs $1.75, Revenue $81.61B vs $79.19B, Data Center $75.2B beat expectations, next quarter guidance $91B ±2%, dividend increased from $0.01 to $0.25—yet the stock remained stuck in the 218-222 range. The "beat + full package = red day" has become a settled fact.
  • Trump Delays AI Executive Order: CNBC reported the delay before noon, which the community interpreted as the real catalyst for the midday fake breakout.
  • SpaceX IPO Filing: 2025 full-year net loss $4.9B / revenue $18.7B, Q1 net loss $4.27B, cumulative loss $41.3B, AI division lost $2.47B in a single quarter—plans to list on Nasdaq with a target valuation of $1T+.
  • Government Invests $2B in 9 Quantum Companies: IBM received $1B (plus $1B self-funded for a new plant), GlobalFoundries $375M, D-Wave / Rigetti / Infleqtion received ~$100M each.

市场氛围：混乱且中性。 SPY 全天被固定在 738-739 的窄幅区间内，基于“同一份协议草案”（被社区戏称为“Peace_Draft_version_234_FINAL_03.doc”），盘中至少出现了 3 次闪涨，随后在遭到否认后立即遭到抛售。 “无法交易的印章”延续了昨天的节奏，成为当天的主旋律。

恐惧/贪婪：贪婪稍微占上风，但极度疲惫。 VIX跌破17引发“清醒阵营”关于“VIX缺口=令人兴奋”的警告；然而，社会上充斥着“战争已经第100次结束”的讽刺，这表明人们对地缘政治叙事的集体麻木不仁。

社区情绪与实际价格走势：早间看跌期权加载→11:30假突破→看跌期权清算→许多人盈亏平衡→13:00开始回到横盘状态。 “下跌80%→盈亏平衡→+35%”这样的评论频频出现，典型的0DTE双杀模式。社区情绪的波动性远高于指数，反映了衍生品杠杆在低波动环境下如何被放大。
